description: Welcome to this beautiful 2-story 3 bath property in Campus Commons, one of Sacramento's most desirable and established communities.  This home offers 2 spacious bedrooms, a versatile 1st-floor den, 2 full bathrooms, and a convenient half bath, all thoughtfully designed for comfortable living. Step inside the cheerful kitchen with easy care wood flooring, custom window coverings and doors that open to a charming and peaceful garden and patio creating the perfect setting for morning coffee or outdoor relaxation. The large primary suite is a true retreat, featuring a private sitting room with French doors, and a view of the mature trees gracing the front of the home. The primary bath offers dual sinks, abundant storage, providing both comfort and functionality. The living room is centered around a cozy wood-burning fireplace, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere for gatherings with family and friends.  Enjoy the Campus Commons lifestyle with access to the Nepenthe community clubhouse, 2 sparkling pools, spa, exercise and social rooms, and tennis courts.  Beautifully landscaped grounds, walking trails, and mature trees enhance the tranquil setting while nearby shopping, dining, and convenient freeway access within reach. This charm and beauty can be all yours.
